clusters.label: Santa Clara · accelerator design

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: The chip designer is one part of a distributed physical system.

facts.text: NVIDIA describes Blackwell GPUs as a 208-billion-transistor design made using TSMC’s custom 4NP process.

metric.unit: billion transistors per Blackwell GPU design
metric.scope: Two-die design; not clock rate or end-to-end performance

clusters.editorialImplication: A cloud or model supplier may still depend on the same upstream foundry and memory ecosystem. Provider diversity is not automatically physical supply diversity.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Which dependencies would remain shared if we changed our cloud or model provider?
clusters.limits: Illustrative NVIDIA-centred cluster, not a census of US chip design; specifications do not establish delivered supply.

clusters.label: Oberkochen · precision optics

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: The accelerator supply chain reaches into precision optics.

facts.text: ZEISS supplies the optical systems used in ASML EUV machines; its 2025 account traces this development to an Oberkochen workshop in 1995.

clusters.editorialImplication: The visible software boom depends on engineering capabilities accumulated across decades. Adding final assembly capacity does not recreate every specialist input.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Are several nominal suppliers exposed to the same specialist equipment chain?
clusters.limits: Use the documented relationship; avoid treating every current ASML system as EUV or repeating old High-NA schedules as completed production.

clusters.label: Veldhoven · lithography

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: Advanced fabrication depends on the machines that pattern wafers.

facts.text: ASML reported sales of 48 EUV lithography systems in 2025.

clusters.editorialImplication: Equipment capacity, installation and customer process readiness are separate steps. A tool shipment does not immediately become qualified chip output.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Is a capacity claim about equipment sold, installed tools, qualified wafers, or customer-ready chips?
clusters.limits: System sales are neither installed-base size nor capacity in one geography; do not compare directly to GPUs or megawatts.

clusters.label: Taiwan · fabrication and packaging

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: Manufacturing and packaging turn designs into usable compute.

facts.text: TSMC reports N2 entered high-volume manufacturing in Q4 2025.
It also describes CoWoS and 3D stacking as part of its high-performance computing offering.

clusters.editorialImplication: A process-node name is only one part of system performance. Packaging, memory and interconnect determine how useful the fabricated compute becomes.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Does the roadmap include qualified packaging and memory availability as well as the logic process?
clusters.limits: Hsinchu map anchor represents a Taiwan manufacturing network. N2 is a process generation name, not a universal literal transistor dimension.

clusters.label: Icheon and Cheongju · AI memory

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: Moving data into the accelerator is a major part of the compute problem.

facts.text: At its March 2026 AGM, SK hynix said its HBM revenue doubled in 2025 and described an established HBM4 mass-production system.

metric.scope: SK hynix; revenue, not bits shipped or market share

clusters.editorialImplication: Memory and logic now require joint planning. More arithmetic throughput alone does not resolve a memory-constrained workload.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Is the workload limited by arithmetic, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, or communication?
clusters.limits: Do not describe SK hynix as the only HBM maker or assign company-wide revenue to one Korean city.

clusters.label: China · manufacturing deployment

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: A major technology market is the factory floor, not only the model leaderboard.

facts.text: IFR recorded about 295,000 new industrial-robot installations in China in 2024, up 7% from 2023.

clusters.editorialImplication: Industrial deployment should be assessed through production constraints, integration and operational performance. A robotics volume measure is a different lens from frontier model rankings.
clusters.buyerQuestion: What can be integrated into this production process, and how will throughput, defects and downtime be measured?
clusters.limits: Shanghai is an illustrative anchor for a national network. Industrial robot installations do not measure humanoids, generative AI use or autonomous-factory penetration.

clusters.label: Singapore · regional infrastructure

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: A dense digital hub still depends on cooling, power and shared infrastructure.

facts.text: MDDI reports Singapore hosts more than 1.6 GW of data-centre capacity.
Its September 2026 statement supports further capacity through measured, sustainable new builds and upgrades.

clusters.editorialImplication: A regional failover design needs physical failure-domain evidence; a second service name alone does not establish independence.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Do our backups share a site, cooling system, power path, or regional dependency?
clusters.limits: Capacity is not energy consumption or available GPU inventory. The cited Digital Infrastructure Bill is at First Reading, not established as enacted by this source.

clusters.label: Bengaluru · global delivery and acquired expertise

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: Scale becomes more useful when it carries domain capability.

facts.text: Infosys completed its acquisition of Florida-based Optimum Healthcare IT on 5 May 2026, adding healthcare-provider expertise and delivery relationships.

clusters.editorialImplication: Trace where a service capability came from and where its experienced team operates. An acquisition can change a firm’s offer before it changes every regional practice.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Which acquired specialists and local references would actually work on our programme?
clusters.limits: This is an Infosys-linked delivery story, not a national services-market metric. US provider capability does not establish ANZ delivery depth.

clusters.label: Victoria · local enterprise delivery

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: A named local implementation is stronger evidence than a global badge.

facts.text: Cognizant’s Federation University case describes live Workday HCM and Payroll, followed by configuration and testing for a new TAFE enterprise agreement.

clusters.editorialImplication: The useful local capability is the ability to translate an operating rule into a dependable system and maintain it after go-live.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Who has delivered the relevant local payroll rules, and will that team remain through stabilisation?
clusters.limits: The case is undated and company-published. It does not prove completed Finance or Student deployment, practice headcount, or an available named project team.

clusters.label: Johannesburg · interconnection

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.headline: Local interconnection is a concrete part of Africa’s technology infrastructure.

facts.text: Equinix opened JN1 in October 2024 with 700 initial-phase cabinets.

metric.scope: JN1 facility, not all Johannesburg capacity

facts.text: The opening release names established deployments by SEACOM, Liquid, WorkOnline and JINX.

clusters.editorialImplication: Geographic proximity and actual interconnection can matter more than a continent-level market label.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Which local networks and exchange points can the service reach, and where is resilience shared?
clusters.limits: Do not substitute the planned 3,475-cabinet full build-out for the initial operating phase. This is one metro, not an Africa-wide capacity estimate.

clusters.label: Canelones · infrastructure and electricity

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.role: Power context and cloud infrastructure investment
clusters.headline: A small market can matter through the combination of energy and connectivity.

facts.text: Google announced construction of a Canelones data centre with more than US$850 million investment in August 2024.

metric.scope: Project investment, not annual revenue or operating capacity

facts.text: UTE’s 2025 energy balance reports that 98% of national electricity generation was renewable.

clusters.editorialImplication: A low-carbon annual grid mix can be attractive, but capacity availability, hourly supply, network paths and service readiness still need separate evidence.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Are we evaluating annual energy mix, available firm power, an operating service, or a construction pipeline?
clusters.limits: No current opening is established by the construction source. National annual renewable share is not a facility’s hourly carbon-free-energy score; it says nothing by itself about spare grid capacity.

clusters.label: Abu Dhabi · AI infrastructure build-out

anchor.precision: Illustrative city or regional anchor, not an asset location or geographic boundary

clusters.role: Capital, construction and planned AI operations
clusters.headline: The announced AI cluster combines local construction with global suppliers.

facts.text: G42’s October 2025 update described Stargate UAE construction underway: a 1 GW cluster within a larger 5 GW campus, with the first 200 MW planned for 2026.

clusters.editorialImplication: A sovereign infrastructure programme is a coalition of physical, cloud, model and networking dependencies. Local location does not imply an entirely local technology stack.
clusters.buyerQuestion: Which parts are operating now, who operates each layer, and what remains conditional on delivery?
clusters.limits: Do not label 200 MW, 1 GW or 5 GW as live without a newer completion source. These are nested phases, not three additive capacities.

milestones.title: Attention changes the architecture
milestones.before: Sequence models often depended on recurrence or convolution.
milestones.whatChanged: The Transformer demonstrated an attention-based architecture with strong translation results and more parallelisable training.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Architecture did not by itself provide instruction following, trustworthy tools, business context or cheap deployment.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: A breakthrough can improve the engine while leaving the rest of the system unfinished.

milestones.title: A long equipment programme reaches customer production
milestones.before: EUV needed usable light sources, optics, process control and an industrial ecosystem.
milestones.whatChanged: TSMC describes N7+ as a high-volume EUV process delivering customer products.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: A demonstrated process still requires yield, capacity, packaging and customer qualification.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: Sudden commercial relevance can follow decades of complementary engineering. Use with the 1995 ZEISS origin story, not as a single-inventor tale.

milestones.title: A prompt becomes a reusable task interface
milestones.before: Many NLP systems needed task-specific training.
milestones.whatChanged: GPT-3 demonstrated broad few-shot performance using task examples in context.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Success varied by task; fluent output was not dependable reasoning or factual reliability.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: One trained model can support many interfaces, while evaluation remains task-specific.

milestones.title: Train for what users ask
milestones.before: A next-token objective did not guarantee helpful responses to instructions.
milestones.whatChanged: InstructGPT combined demonstrations and preference feedback; human raters preferred a 1.3B version over 175B GPT-3 on the evaluated prompts.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Preference on a prompt distribution is not universal truth or safety.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: More parameters and more useful behaviour are different axes.

milestones.title: Rebalance model size and data
milestones.before: Some large models were undertrained for their compute budget.
milestones.whatChanged: Chinchilla showed stronger results by allocating a fixed training budget differently across parameters and data.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Training-optimal choices need not minimise lifetime serving cost for every workload.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: Efficiency progress can come from using resources differently, not only buying more.

milestones.title: Connect generation to actions and observations
milestones.before: A text-only response could not inspect or act on a changing external system.
milestones.whatChanged: ReAct interleaved reasoning and actions in interactive tasks.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Tool access adds permissions, error recovery, state management and verification needs.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: The useful unit becomes a controlled workflow, not one model answer.

milestones.title: Post-training strengthens verifiable reasoning
milestones.before: Pretraining alone left limits on difficult reasoning tasks.
milestones.whatChanged: DeepSeek-R1 research showed reinforcement learning could strengthen reasoning on tasks with verifiable outcomes.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: A verifiable benchmark reward is easier to specify than many messy business goals.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: Ask where success can be checked cheaply and reliably before expanding autonomy.

milestones.title: Progress creates a measurement problem
milestones.before: A fixed task suite becomes less informative as systems improve.
milestones.whatChanged: METR expanded and revised its horizon evaluation; it separately reported bias problems in its newer productivity experiment.
milestones.whatStillBlockedUse: Benchmark performance and work outcomes remain different quantities.
milestones.teachingInterpretation: Measure reliability and realised value independently; revise the instrument when it stops distinguishing systems.

trajectories.title: Longer tasks at a stated reliability
trajectories.chart: Points with confidence intervals; optional connecting line across model cohorts, no extrapolated completion date
trajectories.metric: P50 task horizon in human-expert minutes
trajectories.snapshot: METR TH1.1 comparison published 2026-01-29; deliberately not labelled latest
trajectories.interpretation: Capability rises strongly in this instrument. The threshold is 50% success, not unattended dependability.
trajectories.limits: Self-contained software-related tasks; human-equivalent duration, not agent elapsed runtime. Use one evaluation version. The current dashboard warns estimates above 16 hours are unreliable.
trajectories.decisionImplication: Use representative internal tasks and a required reliability threshold before changing workflow authority.

trajectories.title: Capability growth does not fix the workplace estimate
trajectories.chart: Study evidence cards, not a clean before/after trend line
trajectories.metric: Relative completion time with AI tools in experienced open-source developers

observations.status: Current effect not reliably identified because of selection and measurement changes

trajectories.interpretation: Do not turn an early slowdown or a biased later speedup into a universal claim.
trajectories.limits: Narrow developer/task population; participant selection and concurrent-agent time measurement complicate the follow-up.
trajectories.decisionImplication: Evaluate completed work, quality and review effort in the actual workflow, with a credible baseline.

trajectories.title: Adoption is uneven across real businesses
trajectories.chart: Sector dot plot plus annotated period range; not a fitted S-curve
trajectories.metric: Percent of US businesses using AI in any business function in the preceding two weeks
trajectories.periodContext: Overall use ranged around 17–20% across December 2025–May 2026; the source reports no significant sector shift for Information or Finance/Insurance during that period.
trajectories.interpretation: A sector can be a relatively heavy adopter without its recent usage rate accelerating.
trajectories.limits: Use is not intensity, ROI or employment displacement. The November 2025 wording change prevents a clean join to older series.
trajectories.decisionImplication: Benchmark against relevant tasks and peers rather than a universal adoption clock.

trajectories.title: Electricity demand can rise while individual tasks get cheaper
trajectories.chart: Solid historical estimate and dashed central projection; label each point
trajectories.metric: Global data-centre electricity demand in TWh per year
trajectories.interpretation: Aggregate demand depends on use volume, workload mix and efficiency together.
trajectories.limits: All data centres, not AI alone; projection is conditional, not an observation or site commitment.
trajectories.decisionImplication: Plan capacity from expected workload and power availability; do not extrapolate cost per text answer to an agentic estate.

trajectories.title: Deployment grows unevenly across markets
trajectories.chart: Two dated global observations and a separate China 2024 callout
trajectories.metric: New industrial robots installed per year
trajectories.interpretation: A decade of expansion coexists with flat global annual installations in 2024 and growth in China.
trajectories.limits: Two global points do not establish an S-curve. This measures industrial robots, not generative AI deployment.
trajectories.decisionImplication: Evaluate installation, integration and operational outcomes as separate stages.
